Sixth development release of 0.19.0: a Routing tab on the topology map, circuits between sites drawn as lines, smooth Bendy lines with labels that follow the curve, and cards per row on bands.

> [!CAUTION]
> **This is a development release. It is not stable and it contains bugs.** Do not run it in production or on data you can't restore. Take a backup before upgrading a test install, and expect behaviour to change before 0.19.0. If you run into a problem, please [submit a bug report](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) - every report helps get 0.19.0 right.

### Topology

- **Routing tab.** A fourth tab next to Diagram, Hierarchy and Logical draws how the network routes: routers with their router ID, ASNs and loopback, grouped in movable AS boxes (**Arrange ▸ By AS**); eBGP as thick lines coloured per AS pair and labelled with both AS numbers, families and VRF; iBGP as thin lines with an arrow from route reflector to client; provider networks and circuits on their own layer; cables faint and off by default. A line's panel lists its sessions with peer group, policies in and out, max-prefix, BFD, timers and RPKI caches. Layers have their own eyes, views save the tab's arrangement and display, and it exports to SVG, PNG, PDF and draw.io as "Routing topology". API: `GET`/`POST /api/topology/routing/`.
- **Circuits between sites.** A circuit cabled to a device at both ends is drawn as one dashed line between the two devices, labelled with its circuit ID and coloured by circuit type, on the device and grouped maps and in exports. Its panel shows both sides; a **Circuits** eye hides them.
- **Smooth Bendy lines with labels.** Turning link labels on no longer bends a Bendy line into straight pieces: the line keeps its curve and the port names and addresses are written along it, never upside down. Port names that used to be dropped on crowded rows now fit, and lines no longer paint over a photo's ports.
- **Cards per row.** Right-click a band for **Cards per row**: Auto, a number, or all on one line. Saved with the view and kept by **Arrange ▸ Bands by role**.
- **Save** on the topology bar is the primary button, like other Save buttons, and a band layer's full name shows on hover when it is cut.
